Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-prompt-medium-0092", "row_sha256": "7e6b2701ee50b44c0682cddb3d1b06238f2b0766d68b72c3cecd3dfbfd15ae46", "mode": "/prompt", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Organize the supplied request into a clear prompt. Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "i'm putting together a short report for our club gear log from a routine climbing gear inspection. can you review only these four pieces and the notes below, and say what concerns, if any, the notes point to? don't assume anything about the gear's history beyond what's written, and don't call anything safe or unsafe from these notes alone. if something can't be determined from the notes, please say that.

- harness: label is readable; waist-belt stitching looks intact. there is some fuzz on one leg loop, but i don't know if it's recent.
- rope: about 8 cm of sheath abrasion near the middle; the core isn't visible. we don't have the age or use log.
- carabiner: gate closes and locks when tested. there's a small burr on the nose that catches a fingernail.
- helmet: no visible crack in the shell. there's a shallow dent in the foam liner, though i'm not sure if it's damage or a molded feature.

please make the report a numbered checklist, one entry per item. for each entry, put the inspection evidence before any recommendation. keep it short enough for the gear log, and base any recommendations only on the notes here.", "output": "Draft a short report for the club gear log based only on the four inspection entries below. Identify any concerns the notes point to, if any. Do not assume additional gear history or declare an item safe or unsafe from these notes alone; state when something cannot be determined.

Format the report as a numbered checklist with one entry per item. In each entry, present the inspection evidence before any recommendation. Keep the report brief enough for the gear log, and base recommendations only on the information provided.

- Harness: The label is readable and the waist-belt stitching looks intact. There is some fuzz on one leg loop, but it is unknown whether it is recent.
- Rope: There is about 8 cm of sheath abrasion near the middle; the core is not visible. The age and use log are unavailable.
- Carabiner: The gate closes and locks when tested. A small burr on the nose catches a fingernail.
- Helmet: There is no visible crack in the shell. The foam liner has a shallow dent, but it is unclear whether this is damage or a molded feature."}]
